title: Quantitative Fluctuation Analysis for Continuous-Time Stochastic Gradient Descent via Malliavin Calculus
summary: In this paper, we establish a Quantitative Central Limit Theorem (QCLT) for the Stochastic Gradient Descent in Continuous Time (SGDCT) algorithm, whose parameter updates are governed by a stochastic differential equation. We derive an explicit rate at which the SGDCT iterates converge, in the Wasserstein metric, to a critical point of the objective function. This rate is driven primarily by the magnitude of the learning rate: for a fixed convexity constant of the objective function, smaller learning rates lead to slower convergence.
